name: Boop says something when it reacts
case: The agent's tests fail once while it works, then pass, and three minutes in the turn finishes well. Boop reacts to both, and each time says something: an annoyed huff or 'Basta' at the failure, and at the finish a pleased face that says so ('Finish', 'Done', 'Yay', 'Yatta', 'Phew'). It doesn't make a face and then say nothing when a face that can speak fits as well.
why: characters/boop/steering/guide.md: Boop almost always says something when it reacts, and every face has takes for every feeling and topic
